# elves_scim_group (Data Source)

Looks up a SCIM group (for example an Okta group pushed to Elves) by its name, to get the ID that `elves_scim_group_rule` needs. Groups are created by SCIM provisioning, not by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "elves_scim_group" "developers" {
  display_name = "Developers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Required. Exact name of the group, as shown on the Elves SCIM Groups page.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) ID of the group in Elves.
- `member_count` (Number) Number of users in the group.
